chunks: ʿAbdullāh ibn Miskān narrated from Faḍl ibn ʿAbd al-Malik al-Baqbāq, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who divorced his wife while he was ill, so he said:

She inherits from him during his illness for up to one year if he dies from that illness. She observes the waiting period from the day he divorced her, the waiting period of a divorced woman. Then she may marry when her waiting period ends, and she inherits from him within one year if he dies in that illness. But if he dies after a year has passed, then there is no inheritance for her.

key_terms.الْمُطَلَّقَةِ: the divorced woman; indicating the type of 'iddah she observes
key_terms.تَرِثُهُ: she inherits from him; establishes her inheritance right under the stated condition
key_terms.سَنَةٍ: one year; the maximum period during which inheritance applies
key_terms.طَلَّقَ: divorced; the act initiating the legal ruling
key_terms.عِدَّةَ: waiting period; the prescribed post-divorce term she must observe
key_terms.مَرِيضٌ: ill; describing the husband at the time of divorce
key_terms.مِيرَاثٌ: inheritance; the legal estate right being discussed

ai.seo_question: Does a woman inherit from a husband who divorced her while he was ill?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman divorced by a husband during his terminal illness. She observes the 'iddah of a divorced woman and may remarry after it ends, yet she still inherits from him for up to one year if he dies from that same illness. After one year, her inheritance right no longer remains.
